svg.title: Orbit Remote architecture
svg.desc: Two computers side by side. Left, the viewer computer runs the Electron desktop app: a sandboxed React renderer (Overview, Devices, Connections, Activity, Settings, Session HUD, command palette) that never holds keys, an allow-listed preload.cjs IPC bridge, and the main process with transport.cjs (PinnedAgent checks the SHA-256 pin and TLS policy before any byte), controller.cjs, main.cjs, the connections.json store and a local admin link to its own host on 127.0.0.1:47831 with a bearer token. Middle, requests (pair, sessions, frame, input, clipboard, files, power) travel as pinned mutual TLS inside a Tailscale WireGuard tunnel between the two Tailscale daemons. Right, the host computer's .NET 10 Orbit host receives them on its Tailscale IP at port 47832 and passes five gates in order: link policy, Tailscale whois source check, client certificate pin against the pairing record, grants, and session. Then services: frame pipeline, input, clipboard, files, power; stores host.json, identity.dpapi or identity.pfx and audit.jsonl; a local admin API for its own desktop app; and platform adapters for Windows, macOS and Linux X11 driving the existing signed-in desktop. Every installation runs both stacks; each computer is both viewer and host.
